envelope.def: dev: mean wind ≤6 m/s and no ≥6 m/s downslope (tail) wind (27 of 39 cases)
envelope.note: reasonable as a disclosed envelope but self-selected after the fact: it drops exactly the cases its own launch gate refuses. All flown cases: 84.012 %. Also needs rider ≲13 m/s (vTarget 14 → 31 %), groomed snow (powder 14.7 %), no ice.

massBudget.note: arithmetic reproduced from components.js (+15 %). Deviations: camera 20 g/3 W (shared cam4k 16 g/2.5 W; +4 g for 4:3 SoC, ASSUMED, no ≤27 g 3840×2880 camera found); 4 g/0.6 W NPU instead of the shared 11 g/2.5 W vision computer (justified only because tracking is done in post); structure 47 g ASSUMED (330 g/m² wing incl. fold hinges). With the shared vision computer: 176.525 g, KE cap 12.993 m/s. C0 <250 g: yes.

physics.devClaim: 20 g / 3 W, existence proof DJI Osmo Action 4
physics.evidence: Osmo Action 4 records 3840×2880 but weighs 145 g; RunCam Thumb 2 (27 g) lists 4K only as 3840×2160; Walksnail Moonlight (8.9 g head) is 16:9 only; no ≤27 g 3840×2880 camera found. Sensors (IMX577-class 4056×3040) can read it out, so it is a custom-module item. Not load-bearing: 16:9 2160 rows gives avail 89.0 vs 89.2 % on the subset.
physics.killTest: bench: record 3840×2880@30 on a ≤20 g board for 10 min at −10 °C; else fall back to 16:9 (little avail loss)

physics.assumption: 30° HFOV M12 lens camera on the shared 30 g 2-axis gimbal (Caddx GM2 class) as pan/tilt, 8 Hz bandwidth
physics.evidence: GM2 is made for 19 mm FPV camera heads; no payload rating published; a 12 mm M12 lens + 1/2.3" board is longer/heavier than a 19 mm FPV head (inertia, balance). gimbal 4 Hz → avail unchanged, jitter +0.08 °/s.
physics.killTest: mount the 30° camera on a GM2: measure pan/tilt bandwidth and residual on a shaker at 1–5 Hz

physics.assumption: UWB/GNSS rider pointing error 1.2° (Gauss–Markov) keeps the rider inside the 30°×22.7° sensor
physics.evidence: Qorvo DW3000-family PDoA spec ±5°; best-case ETH study 2.4° average near boresight; erratic at bad antenna alignment. Audit: 5° → avail 78.4 % (subset, from 89.2); 5° with live framing → 10.5 %.
physics.killTest: two-antenna UWB on a 0.76 m glider vs wrist tag at 20–45 m in motion: pointing error RMS ≤2° required, ≥5° kills ensemble avail ≥80 % even inside the envelope

physics.assumption: post reframing + gyro EIS residual 10 % (Gyroflow class)
physics.devClaim: output crop reframed on the phone; jitter 0.71 °/s mean
physics.evidence: reframing uses the TRUE subject direction smoothed (oracle for an offline tracker in the recorded file; plausible when the rider is ≥300 px in frame). EIS 25 % → 16.8 %/s (fails their 12 %/s line), still <3 °/s.
physics.killTest: offline tracker on recorded test footage: subject lock ≥95 % of frames at 20–40 m

physics.assumption: 168.5 g, KE governor at keSpeedCap − 0.7 m/s keeps KE ≤14.9 J
physics.evidence: reproduced; governor overshoots ~0.6 m/s; margin 0.3 J; mass +10 % with the cap re-derived → 15.5 J; GNSS speed error not modelled
physics.killTest: flight log: ground speed ≤ cap + 0.3 m/s in 3 m/s tailwind gusts

physics.assumption: launch gate (10 s mean wind, downslope ≤4.5 m/s) keeps the glider inside its KE/50 m envelope
physics.evidence: gate is an oracle 10 s mean of the true field. Bypass (launch anyway) in tail6: KE 16.4–18.9 J, separation 72–141 m (> 50 m follow-me limit), tail9: 40.8 J. 2 s handheld estimate flips 4/36 cases (none tail6 at these seeds). No in-flight protection against a tailwind rise mid-run beyond windhold.
physics.killTest: run the gate on a real pitot/GNSS estimate in 3–6 m/s downslope wind; abort-and-land logic when downslope wind >4.5 m/s in flight

physics.assumption: auto take-off from groomed snow at every push-off (T0 1.6 N vs 1.65 N weight, 15° slope, claw release)
physics.evidence: static motor power 33.8 W from a 1.8 Wh 1S cell (≈9 A, ≈20 C at −10 °C); powder → stranded (+1 op); thrust −25 % → avail 88.4 %
physics.killTest: snow take-off trials on 10–15° groomed, chalky and wind-packed snow at −10 °C, 20 trials, success ≥95 %

physics.assumption: touchdown/perch on snow (foam belly, claws, anchor 4 N)
physics.evidence: ensemble tdKE max 8.24 J with 8.5 m slide in tail3 (fails own ≤5 J line); hard-pack anchor 1 N/μ 0.5 → avail 85.5 % (min 65.7)
physics.killTest: drop/slide tests on groomed, icy and wind-packed snow; perch hold in 8 m/s cross gusts

physics.assumption: lift-station geofence ends the run; glider lands ahead and waits; rider glides to it
physics.evidence: end trigger is plan.endAt = 1.5 s before the rider stops (oracle timing); a positional geofence makes the glider land in the lift approach/queue area where people bunch up, or 30–40 m beyond the rider’s stop
physics.killTest: field: landing site choice at 3 lift stations with queue; no landing within 10 m of other people

definitionChecks.issue: skiing mask = rider speed >2 m/s and not pick-up phase, instead of fullrun col.riding; recomputed on col.riding the difference is ≤0.5 pp per case (ensemble 64.42 vs 64.63 %). No-fly runs count 0 (correct).

constant 4 + 10 s ASSUMED, not simulated; the end retrieval ride (2 + d/4 s, d 30–40 m) is treated as riding. Charging it: p90 25.3 s. If the glider lands beyond the lift entry, a skate-back is not counted.
p90 used as judged value (brief allows p90 and max); max 3. No-fly runs counted 2 (draw + reholster) though a holster LED could make it 0; conservative.
ground frame beyond 1.5 m, rider frame within; excludes stowed/pick-up phases (glider at rest) — correct. Independent recompute over all non-stowed phases identical (14.616 J).

mean power over FLOWN cases (excludes 9 no-fly runs at 0.3 W) → 63.6 min; including them would give 80.0. Heater 0.6 W charged only during filming (shared enduranceMin helper); a heated cell charged on the lift needs the heater during the lift ride too → 51.2 min. Cross-concept: check whether the others charge heater time on the lift.
definitionChecks.favours: leapfrog slightly via the shared helper; dev choice of flown cases is conservative

definitionChecks.issue: defined post hoc as the cases its launch gate accepts; reported separately (not judged) — fine, but should not be compared with another concept’s envelope defined differently
avail mean, setup p90, ops p90+max, force/KE max, endurance from mean power — as ITERATE_BRIEF; pct() is the shared nearest-rank helper

findings.title: Judged avail fails (64.6 %); passes only inside a self-defined wind envelope
findings.detail: Reproduced exactly. 9/39 runs are refused by the launch gate (all tail ≥6, 2/3 head9, 1/3 crossR9) and head9_s12 gives up (6 %). Inside U≤6 without tail6: 88.3 %; 3 m/s tail already 81.9–85.3 %.

findings.title: KE and 50 m follow-me compliance rely on an oracle launch gate
findings.detail: Gate uses the 10 s mean of the true wind field. Launching anyway in tail6 gives KE 16.4–18.9 J and separation 72–141 m; tail9 40.8 J. Judged keMax 14.616 J has 0.3 J margin; mass +10 % with re-derived cap → 15.5 J.

findings.title: Pointing assumption 1.2° is ~4× better than UWB PDoA specs
findings.detail: DW3000-class AoA is specified at ±5°. With 5°: avail 78.4 % on the dev 6-case subset (inside the envelope) vs 89.2 %; with live framing 10.5 %. Envelope avail ≥80 % is therefore conditional on a pointing source better than UWB alone (e.g. vision tracking on board, which the design removed to save 7 g/1.9 W).

findings.title: Touchdown KE 8.2 J / slide 8.5 m in 3 m/s tailwind fails the concept’s own ≤5 J line
findings.detail: tdKE is not a harmonised metric and the glider is far from the rider, but it is reported as passing in the fullrun scenario only (crossR6_s12, 3.6 J).

findings.title: setupTime is a constant, retrieval ride not counted
findings.detail: 4 + 10 s ASSUMED in every flown case; charging the 30–40 m end retrieval glide gives p90 25.3 s (passes). Skate-back from beyond the lift entrance unmodelled.

findings.title: Camera module 3840×2880 at 20 g has no catalogue part
findings.detail: Not load-bearing (16:9 2160 rows: −0.2 pp avail). The 30° lens on a GM2-class gimbal is unverified (no payload spec).

findings.title: Heater energy during lift charging not charged to the budget
findings.detail: Shared helper adds 0.6 W only while filming; with the heater running for a 6 min lift ride per run endurance falls 63.6 → 51.2 min (still ≥45). Applies to every concept that charges a cell below 0 °C.

findings.title: Independent footageStability exceeds 3 °/s in one flown case
findings.detail: crossL9_s12 subject 3.54 / background 3.68 °/s; all other flown spot cases 0.54–1.01 °/s.

safetyRegulatory: Resort written permission (gate for every concept); a glider landing ahead on the piste at every stop and at the lift approach is an obstacle for other skiers (dev Poisson estimate: ≈2.1 passes within 5 m of the flying glider per run at medium density before avoidance).
EU: 168.5 g < 250 g → C0/Open A1; follow-me ≤50 m enforced by a 48 m hard limit, but violated (72–141 m) if the launch gate misjudges a ≥6 m/s downslope wind.

US: recreational/Part 107 VLOS — the glider flies ahead of the rider within ≤48 m, so the rider can see it more easily than a chase drone, but the rider is also the pilot while skiing; Part 107 Cat 1 over people requires <0.55 lb AND no exposed rotating parts that can lacerate (pusher prop exposed).
Pusher prop + 0.76 m wing at up to 14.6 J; touchdown slides up to 8.5 m (17 m on ice).
credibleEnvelope: Groomed piste, mean wind ≤6 m/s and downslope ≤3 m/s, rider ≤13 m/s, launch gate working, AND pointing error ≲2° (better than UWB PDoA spec): avail ≈82–89 %. Outside that (≥6 m/s tailwind, 9 m/s, powder, ice, UWB-only pointing at ±5°) it fails or does not fly.
verdict: Numbers reproduce exactly (0 diffs). Judged avail fails (64.6 %); setup, ops, force, KE (marginal 0.3 J), endurance pass. Inside its envelope it is the only head-on concept and is credible as a light-wind niche product, conditional on a better-than-UWB pointing source, robust snow take-off and a non-oracle wind gate; KE/50 m compliance is gate-dependent.
